mechanics.claim: Hitting an enemy champion resets the Void Surge (Q) dash cooldown in the direction it was cast.
mechanics.quote: it resets ''{{ais|Void Surge|Bel'Veth}}'' dash {{sti|cooldown}} of the target direction.

mechanics.claim: More than one Void Surge direction's cooldown can be reset if enemy champions are hit in multiple directions.
mechanics.quote: More than one cooldown can be reset if enemy champions were hit within multiple directions.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown refund is applied before the knockup lands, so it happens as soon as the ability hits.
mechanics.quote: ''Above and Below's'' cooldown refund is applied before the {{tip|airborne|knockup}} is applied.
